skill.name: seo-cannibalization-detector
skill.description: Analyzes provided pages for keyword overlap, search intent conflicts, and SEO cannibalization risks, then recommends consolidation or differentiation strategies.
skill.summary: Detects SEO keyword cannibalization across provided pages and suggests clear resolution steps.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: No executable code, prompt injection, or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md. The two static external-command alerts are false positives caused by markdown backticks around a path and an output example.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 25 uses backticks to format a markdown file path, not to execute a command. SKILL.md is prompt text and contains no Ruby or shell execution context.
Lines 78-89 are a fenced markdown output example for an SEO report. The backticks delimit documentation text and do not invoke an external command.

content.value_statement: Pages that target the same keyword can split rankings and confuse search intent. This skill compares provided pages and recommends consolidation or differentiation.
actual_capabilities: Compares provided pages for keyword and topic overlap.
Identifies title, meta description, and target keyword conflicts.
Analyzes whether competing pages serve the same search intent.
Produces a cannibalization report with competing page details.
Recommends consolidation, differentiation, canonicals, and internal link cleanup.
Outlines prevention steps for future content planning.
limitations: Requires the user to provide page content, URLs, keywords, or ranking context.
Does not fetch live rankings, analytics, or Search Console data by itself.
Cannot implement redirects, canonical tags, or metadata changes directly.
Recommendations should be reviewed against business goals and current performance data.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Cannibalization Fixes
use_cases.description: Review competing landing pages and rank the conflicts that most need consolidation or differentiation.

use_cases.title: Plan Distinct Content Angles
use_cases.description: Compare draft topics before publication and assign unique keywords, intents, and page purposes.

use_cases.title: Prepare Client Audit Notes
use_cases.description: Turn supplied URLs, keywords, and ranking notes into a clear conflict inventory and action plan.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Page Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of two similar pages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these two pages for SEO cannibalization. Identify shared keywords, overlapping intent, and the best next action.

prompt_templates.title: Keyword Map Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate audit across several existing pages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this keyword map and page list. Flag conflicts, explain the competing intent, and suggest unique primary keywords for each page.

prompt_templates.title: Resolution Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning after conflicts are known.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a prioritized cannibalization resolution plan using these URLs, target keywords, rankings, and conversion notes.

prompt_templates.title: Full Content Portfolio Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for a large content set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this content portfolio for keyword cannibalization. Group pages by topic, score conflict severity, and recommend consolidation, differentiation, canonicals, and internal link updates.

output_examples.input: Two product pages both target enterprise CRM software with similar titles and buyer intent.
output_examples.output: The skill would flag a high-priority conflict, identify shared title and intent signals, and recommend one primary page plus a differentiated support page.

output_examples.input: A blog cluster includes five articles about local SEO audits with overlapping keyword targets.
output: Groups articles by shared topic and search intent.
Highlights pages that should be merged or retargeted.
Suggests internal link and anchor text cleanup.

output_examples.input: A team provides URLs, target keywords, and ranking positions for related service pages.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce a conflict inventory with competing pages, estimated severity, and practical fixes for each page pair.

best_practices: Provide page titles, meta descriptions, headings, target keywords, and ranking notes for better analysis.
Review the recommendations with search performance data before merging or redirecting content.
Use one primary keyword and one clear search intent for each important page.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a final decision when page content or ranking context is missing.
Do not merge pages only because they mention the same keyword once.
Do not apply canonicals or redirects without checking traffic, links, and conversion value.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide URLs, page titles, meta descriptions, headings, target keywords, and any ranking or traffic data you have.

faq.question: Can it analyze live search results?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes the information you provide and can incorporate live data only if you include it.

faq.question: Does it decide when to merge pages?
faq.answer: It recommends merge candidates, but final decisions should consider traffic, backlinks, conversions, and business priorities.

faq.question: Can it help prevent future conflicts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review keyword maps and content plans before publishing to reduce overlap.

faq.question: What tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.answer: The reviewed file is prompt-only. The static alerts were markdown formatting false positives.
